claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: CGP-54626 is a potent GABAB receptor antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any observed antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly reflecting off-target activity unrelated to GABA signaling.
